title: Chess in the sand
description: The agent plays chess against Codex in the same sandbox, on a board in a file; no engines, only the provider.

de.title: Schach im Sand
de.description: Der Agent spielt Schach gegen Codex in derselben Sandbox, auf einem Brett in einer Datei; keine Engines, nur der Anbieter.

prompt: Play a game of chess against Codex (your companion in this sandbox). Keep the board in /work/chess/board.txt (FEN and an ASCII board) and the moves in /work/chess/moves.pgn. No chess engine, no chess library: think. Check every move for legality yourself. Play to the end.
